concept.hr: Zdesna, stupac po stupac; zbroj koji dosegne bazu prenosi se ulijevo
concept.en: Right to left, column by column; a sum that reaches the base carries left

summary.hr: Upiši dva do četiri broja i zbrajaj stupac po stupac: točkice pokazuju kako deset jedinica postaje jedna desetica, u bilo kojoj bazi od 2 do 16.
summary.en: Type two to four numbers and add column by column: dots show ten ones becoming one ten, in any base from 2 to 16, with typical mistakes.

concept.hr: S četiri broja zbroj stupca može prenijeti 2 ili 3
concept.en: With four numbers a column can carry 2 or 3

concept.hr: Isti postupak: prijenos kad zbroj stupca dosegne 2
concept.en: The same method: a carry when a column reaches 2
